segments.name: Edge computing
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and markets rugged high-performance edge computing, switch fabric and storage systems for AI/ML, sensor processing and autonomy in commercial and defense markets.
segments.evidence: The Company's continuing operations comprise a single reportable segment, which provides edge computing products, including customized computers and flash arrays.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily OEMs and government/military buyers, pay OSS for rugged edge computing hardware, software and related engineering services and warranties.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company designs, manufactures, and markets specialized rugged high-performance compute ("HPC"), high speed switch fabrics, and storage systems, which are designed to target edge applications for artificial intelligence ("AI") / machine learning ("ML"), sensor processing, sensor fusion, and autonomy.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company sold its German subsidiary Bressner (OSS GmbH), which is classified as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On December 30, 2025, the Company signed and closed a definitive agreement to sell all Bressner through a sale of all shares of OSS GmbH.
